Fixed LCG injected through the existing choice randomSource and VM Math.random; match simulationSeed and deterministic PA identities remain production-owned. Reload comparison restores the external injected RNG state explicitly.
Controlled evaluation inputs exercise the official owner but are not naturally generated win/loss matches. Natural cohort results are recorded separately.
No browser visual/playability QA, no adult-career full traversal, no claims of equal policy win rates.
